## Outgoing commands/requests

21 unique declarations; 16 safe Ada; 0 partial; 0 native only; 5 missing.

Counted once at the declaring interface; channel-specific overloads remain distinct. Destructors, buffers and image delivery are excluded.

| Interface | Overload | Status | Qualification |
|---|---|---|---|
| C2Channel | `send(BIT_Command)` | safe_ada | Complete command fields and cached asynchronous result; payload validation is explicit, timeout is not cancellation. |
| C2Channel | `send(CalibrationConfigurationCmd)` | safe_ada | IRMEL-ADA-005: complete optional configuration vector, copied to immutable native storage before provider result release/callback return and then to independent owned Ada values. All 16 UUID bytes and labels, exact interfaces 0/1/2, outer order and three independently sized nested collections are preserved. MaxExclusive and unknown interfaces, invalid UTF-8/NUL, null success and size overflow are rejected, never remapped. Enabled-only submit reuses CompletionPermit, claim_c2_submission, CommonRequestClaim/finish_c2_request, unlocked send, single future worker, cached outcome and deferred cleanup. Independent opt-in one-shot Attached/Enabled metadata registration uses a bounded DROP-INCOMING queue with in-flight draining; callbacks and request completion remain independent. Mock-provider-only qualification. |
| C2Channel | `send(CalibrationStatusCmd)` | safe_ada | IRMEL-ADA-006: complete optional CalibrationStatus, copied to immutable native storage before provider result release/callback return and then to independent owned Ada values. Both independent ordered collections are preserved with no equal-length, correspondence, uniqueness or ordering assumption: active UCI IDs (all 16 UUID bytes, labels, order and duplicates) and completed calibrations (full ID, exact signed int64 nanosecond time tag with no epoch or unit conversion, result, complete fail reason and an independently sized ordered item vector of name/result/fail reason). Results 0..4 are pinned by static assertions; MaxExclusive (5) and unknown values, invalid UTF-8/NUL, null success and size overflow are rejected, never remapped. Enabled-only submit preserves both uint32 command fields without correlation and reuses CompletionPermit, claim_c2_submission, CommonRequestClaim/finish_c2_request, unlocked send, single future worker, cached outcome, deferred cleanup and allocation-free retention. Independent opt-in one-shot Attached/Enabled metadata registration uses a bounded DROP-INCOMING queue with in-flight draining; callbacks and request completion remain independent. Mock-provider-only qualification. |
| C2Channel | `send(CameraCommand)` | safe_ada | Enabled-only C2Channel::send(CameraCommand) through the shared camera completion engine: lifetime claim under the C2 lock, unlocked provider send, Session admission, deferred C2 teardown on pending Close, cached Wait; all 11 fields exact; CommandSuccess=false is a successful response distinct from MEL rejection. |
| C2Channel | `send(CameraProtectCmd)` | safe_ada | Enabled-only C2Channel::send(CameraProtectCmd) through the established request architecture: Session CompletionPermit, C2 lifetime claim under the C2 lock, unlocked provider send, single completion worker, deferred C2 teardown on pending Close, allocation-free post-send retention, cached Wait; all three command fields exact (invalid protect_flag rejected before send); every CmdResp alternative is a successful response distinct from MEL rejection. |
| C2Channel | `send(ConfigSetCommand)` | safe_ada | Complete command fields and cached asynchronous result; payload validation is explicit, timeout is not cancellation. |
| C2Channel | `send(EraseCommand)` | safe_ada | IRMEL-ADA-007: complete command ID and four exact erase types; Enabled-only single send, cached owned future result or explicit MEL rejection. No physical erasure verification, metadata registration, retry or replay. |
| C2Channel | `send(ModeCmd)` | safe_ada | Complete command fields and cached asynchronous result; payload validation is explicit, timeout is not cancellation. |

## Partial and lifecycle functionality

- `Buffer::getBufferAddress() const`: Used by retained Mono8 frame leases with checked host containment and exact-once release; not a general Buffer binding.
- `Buffer::getImageAddress() const`: Used by retained Mono8 frame leases with checked host containment and exact-once release; not a general Buffer binding.
- `Buffer::getSize() const`: Used by retained Mono8 frame leases with checked host containment and exact-once release; not a general Buffer binding.
- `Buffer::release()`: Used by retained Mono8 frame leases with checked host containment and exact-once release; not a general Buffer binding.
- `Channel::disable()`: Image Stop explicitly disables; other families disable only during Close. No reusable standalone common Disable.
- `Channel::enable()`: Typed Enable/Start exists for six families (C2, Image Start, Health, Instrumentation, Track, Scheduling); no StackedImage owner.
- `Channel::registerBuffer(std::shared_ptr<Buffer>)`: Internal Image Open registers provider buffers backed by bridge host storage; application buffer registration is not exposed.
- `Channel::registerMetadataCallback(std::function<void(Channel&,const ChannelCommsTestRep*const)>)`: Only C2 metadata owner exposes this common callback registration. Common requests on other families do not register this callback.
- `Control::attachChannel(const Config&)`: Typed lifecycle for Image/C2/Health/Instrumentation/Track/Scheduling only; no generic or StackedImage attachment. IRMEL-ADA-015: also available through the separate control-only Image attachment, with no acquisition layout or buffer pool. Control-only Receive and frame leases report Provider_Error (native INITIALIZATION_FAILED); Start only enables control. No StackedImage or additional acquisition formats.
- `Control::detachChannel(std::shared_ptr<Channel>)`: Typed lifecycle for Image/C2/Health/Instrumentation/Track/Scheduling only; no generic or StackedImage attachment.
- `ImageListener::onImage(const Channel&,const FrameHeader&,std::shared_ptr<Buffer>)`: Full FrameHeader copied or leased, but image acceptance is strictly Mono8 single-band host memory.
- `FactoryFunctions::getBuffer(std::string_view,std::shared_ptr<::API_Manager>)`: Privately loads provider buffers for the bridge-managed Mono8 host pool only; no generic buffer factory exposed.

## Image capability gaps

- **Control-only Image attachment** — safe_ada: Open_Image_Control uses the same limited Image_Stream owner for capabilities, common KeepAlive/CommsTest, navigation and four required metadata registrations with zero image-layout fields. Start only enables; Receive/frame leases fail explicitly. No image buffers are created, initialized or registered; unexpected callbacks are released without querying sample bytes, with existing uncertainty retention.
- **Mono8 single-band** — safe_ada: Implemented host pool and retained leases; supported() checks capability Mono/8/1, callback separately checks Mono/8/1, nonzero dimensions, known enums and buffer containment.
- **Higher-bit-depth monochrome** — missing: Rejected by capability bitDepth == 8 and frame bitsPerPixel == 8 checks in native/src/ir_stream.cpp. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.
- **Packed pixel formats** — missing: No packed decoder or accepted packed path; buffer arithmetic is width * height bytes.
- **RGB** — missing: Enum represented, but capability/frame format must equal Mono. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.
- **Bayer** — missing: Enum represented, but capability/frame format must equal Mono. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.
- **Multiband** — missing: Capability numberOfBands and frame numBands must both equal one. This is an acquisition restriction only; Open_Image_Control does not validate or use an image layout.
- **Generic application-managed buffers** — missing: Internal bridge host storage only; public registerBuffer/unregisterBuffer equivalents absent.
- **GPU/RDMA buffers** — missing: Not exposed as supported public paths. CPU host address containment/borrowing is not GPU or RDMA qualification.
- **StackedImage** — missing: No StackedImage owner/listener, StackFrameHeader representation, or LOS3D callback path.

## Provider qualifications and count derivation

- Verified upstream Git commit/tree objects fetched from the two authoritative repositories; main has not advanced from the supplied reference base. Frozen objects and licenses are audit evidence, not extra native vendor inputs.
- Source-derived totals confirm 21 outgoing overloads, 14 currently accessible via safe Ada, and 38 metadata registrations, 25 with working paths. The common ChannelCommsTestRep registration is partial overall: C2-only, unlike common outgoing requests across five families. Thus metadata has 24 fully classified safe_ada plus one partial registration with a working C2 path.
- Unique totals count inherited Channel declarations once; all 56 inherited family exposures are separately classified. Counting inherited outgoing sends repeatedly would inflate the hypothesis totals.
- Pinned Squall does not positively qualify Track or Instrumentation; rich field/lifetime behavior is mock-qualified. RequiredIf and Optional are upstream declarations, not provider capability promises.
- The pinned surface is a declaration audit, not normative PDF conformance certification. Upstream inconsistent prose (for example Optional SystemTrackDataResponse wording) is retained as exact tags, not silently reinterpreted.
- Full FrameHeader schema/collections and complete capability enums do not imply support for pixel formats beyond Mono8 single-band. Validation rejects unsupported input rather than silently dropping metadata.
- No upstream unregisterMetadataCallback exists. Disable alone does not promise quiescence; existing retention/deferred teardown behavior remains unchanged.
- The checker proves catalog completeness against pinned bytes and validates reviewed source evidence, not C++ semantic correctness or runtime provider conformance. Native/Ada tests remain required. Extraction is limited to the frozen source dialect with explicit tested exceptions documented in the schema.
- IRMEL-ADA-002 adds opt-in Image and Health NUC_TempData owners. TempPoint stays partial solely because the pinned private tempError has no public accessor; it is neither read nor inferred.
- IRMEL-ADA-003 implements both independent CameraCommand sends (C2 Enabled, Image Attached/Running) and the opt-in Image CameraCommandResp owner. No C2 CameraCommandResp callback exists upstream and none is fabricated; the Image callback never completes a request future.
- IRMEL-ADA-004 implements C2Channel::send(CameraProtectCmd) (Enabled only) and the opt-in C2 CameraProtectCmdResp owner. All three CmdResp alternatives are successful responses, kept distinct from MEL rejection, registration NotSupported, registration failure and provider exceptions; the callback never completes a request future.
- IRMEL-ADA-005 implements both optional C2 CalibrationConfiguration operations and all SubsystemCalibration collections/accepted-interface alternatives. The command and request IDs are independent uint32 values, not inferred response correlation. Safe Ada operations increase from 39 to 41. CalibrationStatus, SubsystemCompletedCalibration and CalibrationStatusCmd remain unimplemented. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-006 implements both optional C2 CalibrationStatus operations and all five missing data declarations (CalibrationStatusCmd, CalibrationStatus, SubsystemCompletedCalibration, SubsystemCompletedCalibrationItemType, SubsystemCalibrationResult). The command and request IDs are independent uint32 values, not inferred response correlation; active and completed collections are independent; time tags are unconverted signed nanoseconds with no epoch. Safe Ada operations increase from 41 to 43. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-008 implements the optional C2Channel::send(SystemTrackDataResponse) as an independent C2 overload: C2 lifecycle, C2 request accounting, distinct C2 request/result owners and probe family, sharing only the pure SystemTrackDataResponse/CommandStatus value conversion with the Track overload. SystemTrackDataResponse and CommandStatus were already safe_ada and are not reclassified. Safe Ada operations increase from 44 to 45. A successful future does not establish operational incorporation. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-009 implements the optional ImageChannel::registerMetadataCallback(OpticalDistortionMap) as an independent opt-in owner and completes OpticalDistortionMap and ForwardRightDown; RowCol was already safe_ada and is reused, not reclassified. Safe Ada operations increase from 45 to 46. The two ODM collections are independent; non-finite doubles are forwarded, not replaced. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-010 implements the @RequiredIfLOSQuaternion ImageChannel::registerMetadataCallback(LineOfSightQuaternion) as an independent opt-in owner and completes LineOfSightQuaternion, reusing the canonical Quaternion and ForwardRightDown representations, which stay safe_ada and are not reclassified. Safe Ada operations increase from 46 to 47. Values are copied, not normalized or converted; receipt is not proof of a usable attitude. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-011 adds the conditionally required SchedulingChannel ownership/lifecycle foundation only: the exact 20-header pinned SchedulingChannel.h closure is vendored (compilation dependencies, not implemented operations), five AMS_MEL_0.1 exports (284 -> 289) and AMS.MEL.IR.Scheduling. SchedulingChannel moves missing -> partial; Scheduling inherited Enable, capabilities, KeepAlive and CommsTest move to safe_ada and inherited Disable to partial (Close only). All 11 Scheduling-specific operations and the AbortTask/IRSTScanTask/IRSTStareTask/IRSTTrackTask types stay missing. Safe Ada operations stay at 47. TaskScheduleDepth 0 is a valid application-managed mode, not absence. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-012 completes only SchedulingChannel::registerMetadataCallback(ExecuteTaskAck) and ExecuteTaskAck (both getters), missing -> safe_ada. SchedulingChannel stays partial and the ten remaining Scheduling-specific operations stay missing. Unique safe Ada operations 47 -> 48; exports 289 -> 295, all AMS_MEL_0.1. No new vendored files (824 unchanged), no task execution, no safe Python/Rust reception. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-013 completes only SchedulingChannel::registerMetadataCallback(TaskExecutingRep), TaskExecutingRep (all ten getters), Task (seventeen defined values; reserved preserved as non-operational, NumTaskTypes rejected) and TaskCompStatus (five values), missing -> safe_ada. SchedulingChannel stays partial and the nine remaining Scheduling-specific operations stay missing. Unique safe Ada operations 48 -> 49; exports 295 -> 301, all AMS_MEL_0.1. No new vendored files (824 unchanged), no task execution, no safe Python/Rust reception. Qualification is mock-provider only.
- IRMEL-ADA-015 separates Image command/metadata attachment from acquisition. No unique upstream operations are newly classified: 50 remain safe_ada; the existing Image lifecycle gains an identity-only attachment profile. Qualification is mock-backed; no minimal-mel-example provider integration was available locally.

## Recommended implementation order

1. C2 EraseCommand and typed EraseCommandType result; no speculative commands.
2. Independent C2 SystemTrackDataResponse send; reuse value conversion, not Track request accounting.
3. Scheduling exec(AbortTask/IRSTScanTask/IRSTStareTask/IRSTTrackTask), send(PrioritizedTrackListCmd) and four remaining callback families as successive vertical slices on the IRMEL-ADA-011 owner foundation.
4. LOS3D dependency closure, StackedImage reception and image-format/buffer extensions as separately qualified slices.
